stories.title: How £1.3million in grants helped 50 Flintshire tourism businesses grow
stories.summary: Fifty tourism businesses across Flintshire have received a combined £929,000 in grants since 2023, delivered by social enterprise Cadwyn Clwyd through the UK Shared Prosperity Fund. The scheme, run in partnership with Flintshire County Council and Business Wales, has helped businesses invest in equipment, technology, new facilities and sustainability measures. stories.title: Housebuilder launches autumn incentive scheme for two Deeside developments
stories.summary: Housebuilder Bellway is offering incentives worth up to £22,500 on selected new homes in Deeside this autumn.
